categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches CI configuration and build scripts across 12 files and carries the Tests label.
categories.rationale: This refactor makes target lists explicit and cleans up a shellcheck suppression in CI scripts without altering test behavior or coverage. The change resolves non-obvious implicit translations where '"all" is added to the build targets unless GOAL is "all" or contains "codegen"', but has no impact on CI reliability, speed, or signal.
